assumptions: FY2026 GAAP diluted EPS stress grid anchored to reported H1 2026 GAAP diluted EPS of $1.75. Constant-share approximation: assumes the H1 diluted share basis remains representative through year-end. Management's Q3 guidance is non-GAAP EPS $1.06-$1.08 and cannot be directly added to GAAP H1 because management does not provide a forward GAAP reconciliation. Bear residual H2 EPS of $1.50 assumes a Q3/Q4 GAAP conversion and a Q4 demand/margin miss from hyperscaler timing, product mix or supply costs. Base residual H2 EPS of $1.80 assumes Q3 near management's non-GAAP outlook after normal exclusions and moderate Q4 execution. Bull residual H2 EPS of $2.10 assumes sustained AI/Ethernet demand, favorable mix and operating leverage yielding a Q4 beat. P/E multiples are explicit stress assumptions—not observed, consensus, fair, normal, or probability-weighted—and test simultaneous earnings and multiple compression/expansion around a dated close.
qualification: All EPS and P/E inputs are analyst assumptions, not observed multiples or consensus. Prices are conditional sensitivities, not forecasts, probabilities or executable quotes. The earnings period differs from the research horizon; assumption and share-basis suitability require review.
